us_0009: FBI agents showed up in Petersburg, a remote Alaskan fishing town, left a business card and asked a donor if he felt misled about Senate candidate Dan J. Sullivan; the donor insisted he wasn’t.

France saw roughly 320,000 people, mostly youths, march against rising living‑costs and education fees; about 70,000 police were deployed, around 300 arrests were made, and protests continued into Halloween.
The nation “fell back” this weekend – clocks shifted back one hour, so sunrise in Boston moved from 7:16 a.m. to 6:17 a.m., giving many of us an extra hour of sleep before work.
Two Spirit Halloween stores were shot on Halloween Eve – one in Fairfield, California, killing a pregnant woman, another in Detroit, Michigan, killing a man; several shoppers were critically injured.
